_comment: Your Legend rules (backend/legend.py). Every value is 0-100, stored as a float so shares of small changes are kept. Pairs are in legend.LEGEND_PAIRS; all but the tension pairs are one scale.

tension._comment: Two separate values that pull against each other: raising one lowers the other by share of the amount.

echoes._comment: A rise of `from` also raises `to` by share of the amount. An echo never echoes again. Falls don't echo.

decay._comment: Out of sight, out of mind: these names fade by points per days since the legend was last written (legendUpdatedAt), smoothly and never below 0. Only that side fades - Obscurity doesn't grow from it.

foraging._comment: Foraging only touches this name: perTrip on every collected trip, emptySite on the trip that empties a site; it never raises it past cap.
foraging.name: wildkin
